meta.name: The Acolyte
meta.description: A hundred years before the rise of the Empire, the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic have prospered for centuries without war. During this time, an investigation into a shocking crime spree pits a Jedi Master against a dangerous warrior from his past.

videos.title: Lost / Found
videos.overview: The Jedi pursue a suspect after a shocking crime.

videos.title: Revenge / Justice
videos.overview: An assassin strikes again, but this time the Jedi are there to attempt capture.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: On a mysterious planet, the tragic journey of two sisters begins.

videos.title: Day
videos.overview: Racing to the next target, the Jedi head to a new world as they close in on the clever assassin.

videos.title: Night
videos.overview: In a dense jungle, the Jedi are put to the test when they confront a rising darkness.

videos.title: Teach / Corrupt
videos.overview: On a distant island, unsettling questions about identity and destiny arise.

meta.slogan: In an age of light, a darkness rises.
